commitResults.messageTitle: refactor(contacts): drop UNIQUE on phone/email, flag duplicates on insert
commitResults.messageBody:
Removes the unique constraints on contacts.phone and contacts.email so
duplicate contact records from different upload sources can coexist.
ContactRepository.upsert now detects collisions (phone first, then
case-insensitive email) before inserting, auto-flags the new record as
'duplicate', and registers a duplicate_pairs row for triage.
findByPhone is made deterministic with ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
